governance.authorized_delivery: The operator explicitly authorized this repository to become public and adopt sharded standard GitHub-hosted Actions plus the existing Chaos Scheduler App. This supersedes inherited runnerless-only and ShadowSync-only hosting restrictions for this target. The retired PR controller will not resume.
governance.review_authority: Q16 authorizes an owner-enrolled local adapter with operational trust. One fresh automatic independent review must match the PR-creation account. Capture that account before and after the adapter creates the PR, and preserve a separate creation binding; no review receipt may establish or change origin. No human technical review, cross-account substitution or same-principal anti-forgery claim.
governance.bootstrap_limits: Qualified producer records and policy admission are staged here. The repository REVIEWER_APP_ENABLED flag must remain OFF through read-only qualification and the accepted successor-control cutover. Legacy required checks stay in place until those gates pass. The previously empty trusted registry cannot admit its own enrollment PR: this source transition requires an exact, independently reviewed owner/admin bootstrap-completion admission; it is not an ordinary delivery lane. Agents cannot bypass or manually merge.
governance.documentation_sequence: SECURITY.md is a Dev-managed whole-file baseline and remains byte-identical until its owner template is updated within G1. CODEOWNERS is create-only in the general baseline; its marked automation blocks are managed, while surrounding custom ownership rules are repository-owned (_ops/baseline/README.md file-behavior table; profiles/pr-automation/README.md and desired_codeowners). Preserve both existing marked CODEOWNERS blocks byte-identically; reviewed additions outside them are allowed. README and delivery docs describe interim bootstrap; source alone does not complete G1.
